dependency_edges.handoff: Cleaned eleven-variable state profiles become elasticity inputs.
Profile differences define the factor-explanation question.
Elasticity describes dependency but leaves underlying causes unresolved.
Profile variables synthesize the nine evaluation indicators.
One indicator from each evaluation branch is selected for forecast CUP.
The trained BP network requires future predictor trajectories.
Scenario trajectories are entered into the network to produce CUP.
Predictions and later observations feed the reliability check.
Hidden-neuron sensitivity reopens the BP architecture choice.
State scenario-two forecasts form the noncooperation baseline.
The selected smooth trajectory supplies the common comparison scenario.
Pooled CUP values become compact targets and memo numbers.
State profile characteristics are cited when proposing actions.
